query: INSERT INTO workspace_user(user_id, workspace_id, role_id) SELECT $1, $2, workspace_user_invite_role.role_id FROM workspace_user_invite_role INNER JOIN role ON role.id = workspace_user_invite_role.role_id AND role.owner_id = $2 WHERE workspace_user_invite_role.invite_id = $3 ON CONFLICT (user_id, workspace_id, role_id) DO NOTHING;
